text.p: LUKoil-Permneft, in which Russia's biggest oil firm LUKoil has a major stake, said on Tuesday it plans a dividend of 5,000 roubles a share with a face value of 1,000 roubles on 1996 results.

First deputy chief executive Nikolai Kobyakov told Reuters the total dividend payment by AO LUKoil-Permneft would be 34 billion roubles, and shareholders would vote on the dividend at the annual meeting on May 25.

LUKoil owns 38 percent of Permneft, Crawford Holdings Ltd 4.89 percent and CS First Boston 13.52 percent.

Earlier LUKoil announced it would start the planned swap of shares in its subsidiaries for a single unified share in LUKoil in two weeks' time. It is offering five LUKoil shares for one Permneft share.
Permneft was last traded on the Russian Trading System on January 10 at $65.
